## PART 2: Customer Service Standards  
### Customer Greeting  
**Upon Arrival:**
- Greet within 2 minutes: "Good morning/afternoon, welcome to FirstUK Bank"
- Smile, make eye contact
- Ask how you can help
- Note customer mood (upset? urgent?)

raw_entities.description: Staff must greet customers within 2 minutes of arrival with a standardised welcome phrase, accompanied by appropriate non-verbal communication (smile, eye contact) and an offer of assistance.
